benchmark_cohort.description: Definition of one benchmark group with include/exclude project lists.

creative_annotation.description: One row per creative asset, versioned. Metrics always join from creative_grain.

creative_grain.description: One row per creative per campaign per day. Money in source currency, normalised downstream.

rules: hook_type (visual|spoken|text) is the DELIVERY channel. The app layer tracks a separate creative-pattern taxonomy (question, bold_claim, ...); complementary, never interchangeable.
Source/describe() reports cohort bands; Backend summarize() reports per-group roll-ups. Both spend-weighted; cross-engine test pins agreement.
This file is the interchange contract. Backend/schema.py is the SQLite DDL implementing it; layer field names (impr vs impressions) map at the boundary.
Benchmarks are spend-weighted means plus p25/median/p75; never average-of-ratios.
Cohorts with fewer than 5 creatives or 3 projects report insufficient-data plus a pooled fallback.
Raw rows are preserved in source_manifest; cleaning is non-destructive.
Annotation rows carry pipeline_version, confidence, and human_verified.
Exports carry the dataset hash and cohort definition in the footer.
